_comment: Ship lines for fleet construction. A line groups the variants that serve together, so the
leader rules (S8.36) can ask whether two ships are of a kind. It is not the SSD Type line:
a Federation CC's type is CC and its line is CA, because the CA line is what it leads.
Adding a line needs no Java change - add it here, then use it in a ship file.
moveCosts are the movement costs ships of the line may pay. A cost does not identify a
line on its own - BCH and CA both pay 1, CL and CW both pay 2/3 - but it cross-checks one:
a ship paying a cost its line does not list has one of the two fields wrong. A line may
list more than one, as CL does for the older Federation light cruisers that pay 3/4.
An empty list means the cost is not fixed and is not checked: a tug pays by what it
is hauling, so its cost varies with the number and size of its pods.
ShipLineCatalogTest enforces the agreement across every ship.
THE ORDER OF THIS LIST IS THE DISPLAY ORDER on the fleet-builder shelf: biggest warship
first down to the smallest, then the civilian hulls. Reorder here to reorder the screen.
civilian:true draws the shelf's dividing rule above the first such line, so the civilian
entries must stay together at the END of the list - ShipLineCatalogTest pins that.
SERIES are an OUTER grouping, used where one empire's hulls fall into generations worth
telling apart. A ship declares one with "series" and the shelf then puts its line groups
inside a series section. Only the Romulans have them so far; a ship that declares none is
grouped by line alone exactly as before, so no other empire is affected. File order is the
display order here too.
